Res.Caption: Name
Res.FullDescription: The name of this rule. It is used to identify on the diagram when the rule has not been fulfilled by the shape schedules.

Res.Caption: Type
Res.FullDescription: The type of scheduling restriction this rule represents.

Res.Caption: Value
Res.FullDescription: The value used in conjunction with the rule's Type to determine whether the diagram's scheduling fulfills the rule.
